title: Came to me defective
text: Came to me defective. i can't really write a review as it would not turn on. I really wanted it to work, it would have been perfect. Alas, it was not to be.

product_metadata.title: Black & Decker Spacemaker Coffee Grinder & Chopper
features: Grind Selection button: Coarse, Medium or Fine Number of Cups Selection button: 4, 8 or 12 cups
Removable Containers; transparent plastic w/metal bottom grinder container and transparent plastic chopper container w/rubberized lid.
Cord Management feature allows you to neatly store power cord in back of the unit while plugged in
description: The latest addition to the Spacemaker line. The new Spacemaker coffee grinder is the perfect complement to any coffee maker. Designed to last and perform, this coffee grinder frees up additional counter space in your kitchen.
